tr: What's the dog's name? / The dog's name is Max.
Is the book good? / Yes, the book is really exciting.
Who are those people over there? / Those are my coworkers.
Good morning, Ms. Becker! / Good morning, Mr. Wagner!
Hello. What's your name? / My name is Megan.
Hi! What's your name? / I'm Lena. And you?
This is my coworker Anna. / Nice to meet you, Anna!
Hello, Mr. Schmidt. How are you? / Fine, thanks. And you?
Hi Jonas, how's it going? / Fine, thanks. And you?
Where are you from? / I'm from the US, from Chicago.
Where do you live? / I live in Berlin, but I'm from Leipzig.
Do you speak German? / I speak a little German.
Do you live here in Hamburg? / No, I'm here on vacation.
Do you have brothers or sisters? / Yes, I have a brother and a sister.
This is my wife, Julia. / Nice to meet you, Julia!
Do you have children? / Yes, I have two children, a son and a daughter.
Excuse me, how much is this? / It's twelve euros.
What time is it? / It's just after ten.
Two rolls and a coffee, please. / Sure. That comes to four euros twenty.
When does the movie start? / At eight o'clock.
What's the weather like in Hamburg? / It's raining, and it's cold.
When is your birthday? / My birthday is May 12.
Are you working tomorrow? / No, I'm off tomorrow.
When are you free, Ms. Weber? / On Monday at ten.
What would you like to drink? / An apple spritzer, please.
What are you having? / I'll have the schnitzel. And you?
Check, please! / Sure. One check or separate?
Good morning! What can I get you? / I'd like a roll and a pretzel.
Can I help you? / Thanks, I'm just looking.
Can I try this on? / Yes, of course. The fitting room is back there.
Can I pay by card? / Sorry, no, cash only.
What size are you? / Size thirty-eight, I think.
When do you get up? / I get up at seven, later on weekends.
Are you free tonight? / I don't know yet. I'll call you.
Do we still have milk? / No, but I'm going grocery shopping today.
Where's the kitchen? / The kitchen is on the right, next to the bathroom.
Excuse me, where is the train station? / Go straight ahead here and then left.
Excuse me, how do I get to the town hall? / Take the first street on the right.
Is it far? / No, only five minutes on foot.
Is there a supermarket around here? / Yes, next to the bank.
Mom, I'm lost! / No problem. Where are you now?
When does the train to Leipzig leave? / At ten twenty, from platform three.
One ticket to Hamburg, please. / One way or round trip?
Excuse me, is this seat free? / Yes, go ahead.
Good evening. I booked a room. My name is Megan. / Welcome! Here is your key.
Where are you? / The train is late. I'll be there at eight.
What's wrong, Jonas? / My stomach hurts.
Hello, Mr. Fischer. What seems to be the problem? / I have a fever and a sore throat.
Are you coming to the movies today? / No, I have a cold. I'm staying home.
I'm sick today. / Oh, get well soon!
Dr. Weber's office, hello. / Hello, I'd like to make an appointment.
What do you do for work, Lena? / I'm a nurse. And you?
Where do you work, Ms. Schmidt? / I work for a company in Stuttgart.
Good morning, Ms. Becker. / Oh, we use du here. I'm Anna.
Can I leave early today? I have an appointment. / Yes, no problem.
Do you have time today? / Yes, I have the day off today.
Hello, Ms. Wagner. How are you? / Fine, thank you. And you?
Hi, Paul! How are you? / Not so good. I'm very tired.
I'm cold. / Here, take my jacket.
I'm coming to Berlin on Saturday. / Great, I'm so glad!
What's wrong, Mia? / I have an exam tomorrow. I'm so nervous.
What do you like to do, Felix? / I like playing soccer and I like listening to music.
Do you feel like going to the movies tonight? / Yes, I'd love to!
What did you do yesterday? / I read a book.
What do you think of the movie? / Great! I really like it.
We're going into town. Are you coming along? / Yes, I'm coming.
Where are you from? / I'm from Chicago.
Who is that? / That's my sister Hannah.
I'm not coming today. / Why?
Aren't you coming along? / Yes, I am! I'll be right there.
What do you want? / I want a coffee, and right now!
Do you have the recipe for the cake? / Yes, it's from my grandma.
Berlin is bigger than Hamburg. I'm right! / Yes, you're right.
How old are you, Max? / I'm eight.
I'm hot. / Me too. Shall we go swimming?
Do you have an appointment? / No, unfortunately not. Is it possible without one?
Can I pay by card? / No, sorry. Cash only.
Where do I register my address? / At the citizens' office. But you need an appointment.
Shall we go shopping on Sunday? / No, stores are closed on Sundays.
The heating is broken. / Why don't you call the building manager?
Would you like some more cake? / No thanks, I'm full. That was really delicious.
You're a really good cook. / Thanks! The recipe is my grandma's.
I passed the exam! / Congratulations!
I wrote the text all by myself. / Well done!
You look good! Were you on vacation? / Yes, two weeks in Spain.
You have a lovely apartment. / Thanks! We've only lived here since March.
Come in! / Oh, it's really cozy here.
This is our baby, Paul. / He's so cute!
You speak German very well. / Thanks, but I'm still learning.
Your presentation was very good. / Thanks, I'm glad to hear it.
That jacket looks great on you. / You think so? It was really cheap.
You look really good today. / Thanks, you too!
Why are you looking at me like that? / You have a beautiful smile.
You look great today. / Thanks! So do you.
I brought you a coffee. / You're really sweet. Thanks!
Here, flowers for you. / Oh, that's so sweet of you!
Why are you laughing again? / You make me laugh.
I sing in a choir. / I believe it. You have a lovely voice.
I like your style. / Thanks! The jacket is from the flea market.
Your hair looks great today. / Thanks for the compliment!
I like talking with you. / Me too. The time goes by so fast.
Can I ask something? Are you taken? / No, I'm single.
Can I buy you a coffee? / Sure! I know a nice café around here.
Are you free on Saturday? / Yes, why?
Would you like to go out to eat with me sometime? / Yes, I'd love to! When?
Can I have your number? / Sure, give me your phone.
That was a lovely evening. Shall we see each other again? / That would be nice.
Will you go to the movies with me on Friday? / Yes, I'd love to!
Shall we go out to eat sometime? / We'll see.
You have gorgeous eyes. / Do you say that to everyone?
I like you. / I like you too.
You're finally back! I missed you. / I missed you too.
Can I buy you a drink? / Thanks, but I have a boyfriend.
Do you have time for a date this weekend? / Thanks, but I'm already taken.
Would you like to go dancing with me on Saturday? / That's sweet of you, but no thanks.
I think I'm in love with you. / That's sweet, but let's just stay friends.
The store is closed today. It's a holiday. / Oh, I see! Then we'll go tomorrow.
How was the movie? / Well … not that great.
Ouch! That's hot! / Careful, the tea is fresh.
Oh! You have a dog! / Yes, that's Max.
The class is canceled today. / Oh, too bad.
Whoops! I almost fell. / Everything OK?
Oops! I forgot your name. / No problem, my name's Jana.
I've got the tickets for the concert. / Great! Thanks!
We're going to the sea this summer. / Fantastic! Where exactly?
So we're meeting at eight at the station? / Exactly!
Unfortunately I can't come on Saturday. / Too bad! Maybe next time.
Can you help me for a second? / Sure! What's up?
I'm too old for German. / Nonsense! You're learning really well.
Watch out, the car! / Thanks! That was close.
Darn! The bus is gone. / The next one comes in ten minutes.
I won the lottery. / Really? How much?
You're wearing socks with sandals! / So what? It's comfortable.
My brother rode his bike to Italy. / Whoa! How long did that take?
The train is late again. / Oh well. That's the railway for you.
Hey! Wait up! / Oh, hi Ben!
Well? How was your day? / Good, but long.
Eek! You scared me! / Sorry!
We were up the Zugspitze yesterday. / Amazing! Was it cold?
I found your key. / Thank God!
Achoo! / Bless you!
(lunchtime greeting) / (lunchtime greeting) Are you going to the cafeteria too?
Wait a minute! That's my seat. / Oh, sorry!
Oh no! I left my phone on the train. / Call the railway quickly!
Today is a holiday, remember. / That's right! Then the stores are closed.
We're meeting at seven in front of the movie theater. / Got it! See you then!
I'm done with work. / Excellent! Then we can go.
Sorry I'm late. / Nah! We've only just started.
The printer isn't working again. / Oh man! Not again.
